content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCH Sangrur Technician (Radio Diagnosis) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) post at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital Sangrur is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. in Radiological Imaging Technology OR a B.Sc. in any subject / B. Pharmacy with a minimum two-year Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology from a recognized board or university.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need to have a minimum of 01-year of internship or experience from a large hospital, with specific experience in CT and MRI procedures.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 30 years. However, deserving and bright candidates may be given age relaxation as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) position at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital Sangrur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview in person at the specified venue.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their Bio-data, recent passport size photograph, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, Educational and Experience Certificates in original, and one set of self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at H.R.D Dept. 3rd floor, New Building, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Sangrur, Punjab.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a written examination followed by a skill test.
